description: Lists the account's documents, newest first, optionally filtered by status, with limit/offset pagination (limit max 100). A document voided because a signer declined has status 'cancelled' and carries declined_by (name, email, reason); the 'declined' filter returns exactly those documents.

status.description: 'declined' is a virtual filter: envelopes voided by a signer's decline (their stored status is 'cancelled')

name: list_documents
title: List documents
